q: The parable of the Good Samaritan teaches Christians to show love and mercy to ____. (P4)
options: everyone in need, including neighbors and strangers

explain: The loving father welcomed back his repentant wayward son with joy.

q: The king renowned in the Bible for asking God for wisdom to govern Israel was King ____. (P4)
